title: Delhi court denies bail to Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam in Delhi riots conspiracy case
description: A Delhi court on Saturday dismissed the fresh bail applications filed by Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in the Delhi riots conspiracy case. Additional Sessions Judge (ASJ) Sameer Bajpai passed the order.
